column5: GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 17. `CO:3156-3173` a `Linear` owned place at return with no claims or partial paths is removed from the owed set when its empty-claim frontier validates with `&|_, _| true`. Wrong program: "a function that returns while holding a Linear place whose type owes nothing under an empty claim frontier".
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 18. `CO:3490`, `CO:3582` `saturating_sub(1)` gives ordinal 0 for an empty block instead of an error.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 19. `CO:6461` `_ => {}` in `apply_operation`: unlisted operations get no access check, no argument overlap logic and no stored-effect staging. Wrong program: "a read through a suspended referent by one of the unlisted structural operations". The reader notes descriptor-loan checks list the same operations at `CO:1368-1406`.

GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 20. `CO:5824-5826` `discard_subtree` does nothing when the place has no structural contract; reachable from `CO:2518` with no prior contract check.
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 21. `CO:4302-4308` `remaining_at_return` with no effect summary returns all live references; the caller was not read.
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 22. `CO:6008-6019` the "operation result remains pinned" check is skipped when `psi_operation()` is `None`.
GROUP: **optimization-unit-semantics, `current_ownership.rs` (22)** | 23. `CO:6636-6669` two ordinary (non-reference-bearing) arguments to one call are not checked against each other here.
